newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Eight killed in Colombia peasant massacre.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in Colombia peasant massacre.

text.p: A suspected right-wing paramilitary gang has killed eight peasants in a remote region of northwest Colombia, police said on Wednesday.
The attack took place in Choco province on Sunday but details only emerged late Tuesday from the area, to which the main means of access is a six-hour boat trip.
A local government official, Luis Mosquera, said 30 armed men carried out the killings in a rural area near the town of Riosucio. The victims were called by name, taken from their homes and shot.
Mosquera said the gang was probably a paramilitary group which suspected the peasants of collaborating with leftist rebels.
Troops have been sent to the region to track down the killers, military sources said.
Last year, 457 people died in more than 80 reported massacres across Colombia. One of the worst-affected areas was the north of Antioquia province, which borders Choco.

Prosecutors there on Tuesday charged 19 men, including a junior army officer, a police commander and a town mayor, with belonging to a paramilitary group. Businessmen and landholders were among others charged.
